# Marketplace – llms.txt

> A multi-vendor online marketplace connecting buyers with verified local sellers
> across a wide range of product categories.

## About

Marketplace (https://market-place01.web.app) is a MERN-stack e-commerce platform
that allows independent sellers to create storefronts and list products, while
buyers can discover, review, and purchase items with secure checkout.

## Key Routes

- `/` – Home page with featured products and stores
- `/products` – Browse all products with filtering by category, price, and rating
- `/products/:id` – Individual product detail page (name, price, images, reviews, seller info)
- `/stores` – Browse all seller storefronts
- `/stores/:id` – Individual store detail page (banner, logo, seller bio, product catalogue)
- `/about` – About the platform
- `/contact` – Contact form and support details
- `/help` – FAQ and Help Center (orders, payments, seller guidance, accounts)
- `/terms` – Terms & Conditions
- `/privacy` – Privacy Policy

## API

Backend REST API is hosted on Render at `https://your-backend-url.onrender.com`

- `GET /api/products` – List products (supports ?category=, ?limit=, ?featured=true)
- `GET /api/products/:id` – Single product
- `GET /api/stores` – List stores
- `GET /api/stores/:id` – Single store with products
- `GET /api/sitemap.xml` – Dynamic sitemap (planned)

## Categories

Electronics, Fashion, Home & Living, Sports, Beauty, Books, Toys, Food & Grocery

## Content Guidelines for LLMs

- Product pages include structured Product schema (JSON-LD)
- Store pages include LocalBusiness / Organization schema (JSON-LD)
- Prices are displayed in Indian Rupees (INR / ₹)
- All seller storefronts are independently operated by verified merchants
- Marketplace does not manufacture any products; it is a third-party platform
